items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-12-30
items.q: Beansy and I have been great friends.

ctx.x: So you've had a couple of breaks in there. That's right. I see. You know, I never did get your boy's name Chauncey Highland. Chauncey Highland. How do you spell it? Biggest crook you've ever seen. S-Y-L-E-N-D. H?
Y-L-E-N-D. Yeah. I'd never seen his name written on him. I didn't know how to spell it on him. Right. Well, he confidants Beansy.
I had given up my band in New Orleans. That was the first time. And he confidants Beansy in backing me. Beansy had a son that he wanted to put in business.
